comparability_requirements: OCF and PPE purchase share exact period and basis
design.currency_basis: same verified financial currency; no inferred FX conversion
design.daily_delta_use: only newly effective post-baseline validated change; preserve M3 cutoff lineage
directional_core_usage: separate operating cash generation from reinvestment absorption
higher capex is not inherently negative
use OCF less PPE capex, never an inferred maintenance-capex result
design.entity_attribution_basis: same issuer, consolidation scope, statement basis, and attribution basis
forbidden_derivations: generic investing cash flow as capex
partial capex subtraction labeled as company-defined FCF
design.initial_analysis_use: eligible as absolute evidence when valid and material
message_usage: preferred label: OCF less PPE acquisition cash outflow
if FCF is used, qualify it as PPE-only and not management-defined FCF
design.missing_data_behavior: PPE cash-conversion unavailable; OCF may remain independently usable
design.monitoring_baseline_use: may enrich baseline; enrichment is not Daily Delta
non_applicable_or_caution_sector_familie: asset-light issuer with material intangible investment
required_validation_tests: same-basis arithmetic and complete input lineage

safe_derivations.formula: semantic-aware sign normalization to positive magnitude
safe_derivations.name: ppe_capex_positive_outflow

failure_conditions: period, currency, entity, or basis mismatch
safe_derivations.name: ocf_less_ppe_capex

design.single_quarter_vs_cumulative_semantics: QTD, YTD, FY, TTM, and point-in-time remain distinct; no label-based guess
design.valuation_usage: context for denominator quality only; no multiple, price target, or valuation fact
design.warning_kill_condition_use: may support warning when material and contextual; no one-period automatic kill
